snippet.title: Lost Camp - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/ARANJA?
